project.name: tmcp
project.identity: A task-specific context packet compiler that turns skills, rules, and evidence into compiled, auditable workflow packets.
project.audience: Operators and agent workflows that need the smallest relevant context packet for a task rather than a manual import of every available instruction.
project.core_loop: Select task-relevant skills, rules, and evidence, compile a bounded packet, recompile when inputs change, retain an audit trail, and hand the packet to the authorized workflow consumer.
project.north_star: Task-specific context becomes smaller, more relevant, and more auditable because compilation is explicit instead of relying on manual imports.
not_this: A generic skill catalog without task routing
A claim that compiled context is correct merely because it has a hash

mvp.definition: A task can compile a bounded packet from selected skills, rules, and evidence with a readable manifest and audit trail.

complete_product.definition: TMCP reliably routes, compiles, recompiles, and audits task-specific packets across its stable supported surfaces while keeping experimental behavior explicitly separate.

outcomes.name: A workflow receives only the relevant context inputs for its task, with source and selection reasons visible.

layers.intended: Operators spend less context budget on irrelevant manual imports and can inspect what was selected.
layers.planned: The repository defines TMCP as a compiler for skills, rules, and evidence.
layers.implemented: Stable compilation and experimental surfaces exist in the current repository.
layers.verified: README establishes the compiler model and current status; full consumer and recompilation parity was not run here.

evidence.note: States that manual imports are not TMCP and defines the compiler loop.

blockers.summary: Consumer-specific packet relevance and recompilation behavior require broader execution evidence.

outcomes.name: A compiled packet can be traced to its inputs and regenerated when those inputs change, without treating identity hashes as behavior proof.

layers.intended: Context changes remain understandable and recoverable across task runs.
layers.planned: Audit trail and recompilation are explicit product concepts.
layers.implemented: The repository contains stable and experimental compilation/audit surfaces.
layers.verified: No full input-change, recompile, or downstream behavior matrix was executed here.

evidence.note: Defines compilation, recompilation, and audit trail scope.

blockers.summary: Artifact persistence, consumer parity, and behavior verification remain open for the experimental surfaces.

verified.note: Documented claims only; no consumer matrix was run here.

drift.summary: TMCP's compiler identity is clear, but consumer relevance, recompilation, artifact persistence, and experimental-surface parity remain incomplete verification areas.

evidence.note: Separates stable and experimental surfaces without full consumer proof.
